commands.name: ping
commands.description: Check if the bot is responsive
commands.longDescription: Simple health check command that replies with 'Pong!' to verify the bot is online and responsive.

commands.name: flip
commands.longDescription: Flip a virtual coin and get heads or tails. Useful for making decisions or settling disputes.
tips: For gambling with coins, use /gamble instead

commands.name: roll
commands.longDescription: Roll one or more dice with a specified number of sides. Optionally hide the result from others.

options.name: sides
options.description: Number of sides on the die

commands.name: image
commands.longDescription: Generate an AI image using DALL-E 3 based on your text prompt. Creates unique, high-quality images.

examples.input: /image query:"A futuristic football helmet with LED lights"

tips: May take a few seconds to generate

commands.name: namecolor
commands.description: Change your display name color in the server
commands.longDescription: Customize your name color in the server by creating a personal color role. Choose from predefined colors or specify any hex color code. Each user gets their own unique color role that only affects their display.

examples.output: Your name color has been set to #9B59B6
Your name color has been set to #E91E63
Available colors: red, blue, green, purple, orange, pink, cyan, gold, white
Your custom name color has been removed.

tips: Predefined colors: red, blue, green, purple, orange, pink, cyan, gold, white
Use any hex code like #FF5733 for custom colors
Your color may be overridden by higher-positioned roles
Bot needs 'Manage Roles' permission to work
